services.name: RV & Tent Sites
services.desc: At Boyd’s Key West Campground, we know your vacation isn’t complete without your canine companion. That’s why we proudly welcome well-behaved dogs and provide a tropical paradise where pups can wag their tails alongside the rest of the family. Whether it’s morning walks under the palms, sunset strolls by the marina, or lazy afternoons snoozing in the shade, your dog will feel just as at home as you do. We’ve got more than just a “pets allowed” policy-we embrace the joy that dogs bring to the campground experience. services.desc: Ready to glide across crystal-clear waters, spot tropical wildlife, and experience Key West from a whole new perspective? At Boyd’s, our Kayak & Paddleboard Rentals make it easy to explore the calm, scenic waters right from the campground-no boat required! Whether you’re a seasoned paddler or a first-timer, kayaking and paddleboarding are relaxing, fun, and the perfect way to soak in the beauty of the Florida Keys. Choose from beachfront or terrace rooms, each designed for a relaxing stay just steps from the lake. Enjoy a private balcony or terrace, plush bedding, and modern amenities.
